dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body region toward the visible posterior peduncle.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple sets of faint, linear, light-colored marks (likely rake marks) on the mid and posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial, linear, light-colored scarring visible on the mid and posterior dorsal area.
